$comment: Verify & Recover connector — the loop's least-privilege runtime capability for
reading CI logs and writing status back to the issue/PR thread. Treat MCP
connectors like production dependencies: read-only first, scoped tokens,
logging on. The loop should be able to read CI logs and write to the thread —
never hold write access to secrets or production.

inputs.description: Scoped, read-mostly GitHub token (issues/PR read+write, actions read).
